# Upgrade to Express v5

Express 5 removes a number of deprecated APIs and changes the default behaviour of several others. The most disruptive change is that path route matching no longer accepts bare `*` — use a named wildcard such as `/*splat` instead.

## Changed defaults

`res.status()` now rejects out-of-range codes, and rejected promises returned from a middleware are forwarded to the error handler automatically.
